meta.comment: Phase-3 Talent data. Placeholder flat ladder — Phase 10 Balancing retunes.

definitions.name: Dull
definitions.description: A slow, unremarkable learner — new arts take hold only through great effort.

definitions.name: Slow
definitions.description: A deliberate learner who needs time and repetition before lessons stick.

definitions.name: Ordinary
definitions.description: An average aptitude for learning — no gift, but no hindrance either.

definitions.name: Bright
definitions.description: A quick mind that picks up techniques and crafts with noticeable ease.

definitions.name: Gifted
definitions.description: A naturally talented learner whose insight shortens the path to mastery.

definitions.name: Genius
definitions.description: A rare intellect that grasps profound arts after a single glance.

definitions.name: Prodigy
definitions.description: An unheard-of talent — the Dao itself seems to bend toward their understanding.
